title: Agribusiness Management, Minor (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: 21cr bulletin exact. Pairs with the already-built Agribusiness Management major (code AGBM); minor code AGBMMIN avoids colliding with the major's own code. Prescribed AGBM 102 (3cr, prereq-free) + AGBM 106 (3cr, needs one of AGBM 101/ECON 102/SCM 200/STAT 200-240-250) + AGBM 200 (3cr, prereq-free). Foundation Course requirement filled with ECON 102 (3cr, prereq-free) rather than AGBM 101 -- deliberately, since ECON 102 also satisfies AGBM 106's own prereq gate, closing that chain with one course instead of two. The bulletin's Additional Elective Requirement 'Option B -- select 9cr from any 400-level AGBM courses' pool is filled entirely with codes that resolve via courses already in this minor (ECON 102 and AGBM 106): AGBM 407 (3cr, needs ECON 102 and AGBM 106) + AGBM 455 (3cr, needs ECON 102) + AGBM 470A (2.5cr, needs ECON 102) + AGBM 470B (0.5cr, needs AGBM 470A) = 9cr exactly. Computed total: 3+3+3+3+3+3+2.5+0.5 = 21cr, an exact match to the bulletin's stated total, with zero hidden-prereq additions beyond the minor's own Foundation Course pick.
